text:
Jiri Kulich missed more than two weeks before being cleared on Nov. 4, and Buffalo Hockey Beat reported he has been leaning on teammates through a tough stretch. We don't know the details of what he's dealt with and won't guess. What we can see is the hockey since he returned: he played 13 minutes against Columbus on Friday and had four shots, and Bleacher Report's Joe Yerdon saw him "feeling it early" against Vegas on Sunday.

He has 3 points in 9 games. The Sabres take almost 57% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, eight points better than without him, which is a strong sign in a small sample. His shooting is at 7.7% against a range we'd put between 10% and 16%.

He's 22, a 2022 first-round pick from Czechia who scored 12 points in 7 games at the 2024 World Juniors and has a heavy shot (82nd percentile). Our projection runs from 8 to 20 goals because the sample is short. The thing to watch is his minutes; he's at 13 a night, about three below his usual, and he's good enough for more.
headline: Kulich is back, and leaning on the room
